# One way door with a hidden hinge

`customer_support.mm.ticket_triage.one_way_door_with_a_hidden_hinge` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Triage is reversible in the tool and expensive in the relationship.

Reassigning costs a click. But the customer has already been told, the clock has already been spent, and the receiving agent starts from a story someone else wrote. Cheap-to-undo in the system is not cheap-to-undo for the human on the other end.
